    groups = defaultdict(list)
    idx = 3

    for i in range(n):
        c = int(data[idx]); v = int(data[idx + 1]); idx += 2
        groups[c].append(v)
    # For each color, the best gem (max value) is the representative
    reps = []  # (value, color)
    for c, vals in groups.items():
        vals.sort(reverse=True)
        reps.append((vals[0], c))
    reps.sort(reverse=True)
    forced = reps[:m]
    total = sum(v for v, _ in forced)
    # Pool: all gems except the forced representatives
    # For each forced color, remove exactly its top gem
    forced_colors = set(c for _, c in forced)
    pool = []
    for c, vals in groups.items():
        if c in forced_colors:
            pool.extend(vals[1:])
        else:
            pool.extend(vals)
    pool.sort(reverse=True)
    total += sum(pool[:k - m])
    print(total)

from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    N = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    K = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    M = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for _ in range(N):
        c = int(data[idx]); v = int(data[idx + 1]); idx += 2
        groups[c].append(v)
    colors = []
    for c, lst in groups.items():
        lst.sort(reverse=True)
        colors.append((lst[0], c))
    colors.sort(reverse=True)
    chosen = set()
    mandatory = 0
    for i in range(M):
        top, c = colors[i]
        mandatory += top
        chosen.add(c)
    pool = []
    for c, lst in groups.items():
        if c in chosen:
            pool.extend(lst[1:])
        else:
            pool.extend(lst)
    pool.sort(reverse=True)
    extra = sum(pool[:K - M])
    print(mandatory + extra)
